## Summary
Adds a machine-wide load gate so heavy Loomwright work (full suites) waits while the machine is overloaded and starts again when load falls. It never kills anything. This follows the 2026-10-05 S3 wave-1 freeze: load1 119 on 12 CPUs, then a watchdog reset. There, the per-repo CI slot cap did not hold across clones with local origins, fixtures with their own state dir, and suites run outside `ci-local` (requirement `parallel-automate/16`).

## Changes
- New `loomwright/scripts/machine-load.sh [--json]` reports `load1`, `cpus`, `load_per_cpu`, `mem_pressure` and `state=ok|busy|overloaded|unknown`. Load is busy at 2× CPUs and overloaded at 3× (override with `LOOMWRIGHT_LOAD_BUSY` / `LOOMWRIGHT_LOAD_OVERLOADED`). Memory uses the OS's own pressure level: macOS `kern.memorystatus_vm_pressure_level` 2/4, Linux `MemAvailable/MemTotal` < 15 % / < 8 %. It is fail-SAFE: anything unreadable is `unknown` with exit 0.
- `ci-slot.sh acquire` runs machine-wide admission under the existing mutex, after the fairness check:
  - `overloaded` holds the caller in its queue place and re-checks every 15 s.
  - `busy` admits at most one holder machine-wide.
  - `unknown`, or a broken or missing reader, grants as `ok`.
  - One machine state dir is shared by every repo key and every `XDG_STATE_HOME`, so a clone with a local-path origin joins the count.
  - An acquire nested inside a live holder (self-tests under `ci-local`) folds into that holder.
  - `status` shows `held for load: <state> load1=<n>`.
  - `--wait` timeout behaviour is unchanged.
- The gate sends no signals (grep-tested). `status`, `dir`, `release` and `ci-local --last` never wait on it.
- `scripts/test-ci-local.sh` and `test-ci-slot.sh` pin a fixture reader and sandbox the machine dir, so a loaded dev machine cannot hold the suite under test.
- `AGENT_GUIDELINES.md` §"Pre-push: one command": run suites through `ci-local`, never a bare run-self-tests.sh in a loop.
- `changelog.d/parallel-automate-16-machine-load-guard.md` fragment (minor). No version files are edited.

## Test Plan
- `bash loomwright/scripts/test-machine-load.sh` passes 17/0, all on fixtures: macOS and Linux readers, the pressure-level mapping, `unknown`.
- `bash loomwright/scripts/test-ci-slot.sh` passes 50/0: overloaded hold and release, busy single holder, cross-repo-key count, nested fold, fail-SAFE reader, no-signal grep.
- `bash scripts/test-ci-local.sh` passes 68/0.
- Full `bash scripts/ci-local.sh`: PASS at 4b7eade (674 s).
- Part 0 load attribution is recorded in the requirement's `## Evidence`. Candidates 1–4 were confirmed. Scope was amended for load that is not Loomwright's, which this gate cannot control.

## Not verified
- **AC7: three concurrent `ci-local` runs from three scratch clones on the owner's machine.** Not run, because the machine was shared with active lanes and other load (load1 82 earlier in the session). Also a design limit: runs started at the same instant all see the same `ok` reading, since load1 lags. That needs a quiet-machine run; a staggered-start follow-up is proposed. (subtask 1)
- **`machine-load.sh` Linux reader on a real Linux host.** Only fixture `/proc` was exercised locally; CI Linux will cover it. (subtask 1)

## Task
Closes parallel-automate-16-machine-load-guard
